observed_value: cost_currency flagged as U_GBP/U_EUR on 6 rows
anchor_value: Cost and Market Value columns are USD-denominated in the schedule totals

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Header places Principal/Shares before Cost and Market Value; the foreign currency symbol belongs to Principal/Shares, not Cost.
Reconomy row shows a non-USD symbol in the Principal/Shares area, followed by Cost 3,113 and Market Value 3,339.
Environmental Industries Total shows Cost and Market Value with USD dollar signs.

findings.detail: Foreign principal/share currency symbols were propagated into cost_currency even though Cost and Market Value are USD-denominated schedule columns.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell currency check aggregated over six rows. The raw schedule header has Principal/Shares at the currency-symbol position and separate Cost and Market Value columns; representative non-USD rows show the foreign symbol before the principal/share amount, while cost and fair-value totals use USD. Therefore the stored non-USD cost_currency is a real extraction/mapping defect, not a valid cost denomination.
